facts.anchor: JUNE toppled, lifeless, to the ice.

facts.fact: 西德妮终于抓住了米奇生命的那根线。
facts.anchor: she finally caught the thread of Mitch’s life

facts.fact: 出现两个米奇，两个都和她一样为这次复制感到意外。
facts.anchor: Both Mitches looked as surprised as she was by this duplication.

facts.fact: 塞雷娜淹他、割他、射他、冻他，一遍遍杀死米奇的分身。
facts.anchor: Serena drowned him, cut him, shot him, froze him

facts.fact: 西德妮用她平时对 Dol 用的那种语气命令米奇留下。
facts.anchor: using the same tone she took sometimes with Dol

facts.fact: 西德妮承认格雷医生有一点说对了。
facts.anchor: Dr. Gray was right about one thing.

facts.fact: 西德妮认定塞雷娜要全世界和其中每个人都照她的意思做。
facts.anchor: Serena Clarke expected the world, and everyone in it, to do exactly what she wanted.

facts.fact: 最后西德妮说要先找到维克多。
facts.anchor: “First,” she said, “we have to find Victor.”
